title.zh: Meta收购Conductor：云端版11月20日关停，原产品明年退场
title.en: Meta收购Conductor：云端版11月20日关停，原产品明年退场

current_state.zh: Meta has acquired AI coding-agent management tool Conductor, moving its team into Meta Superintelligence Labs while winding down the original product, with cloud access closing on November 20.
